description: This file defines a React component called ProtectedRoute that wraps around other routes to enforce authentication. It uses React Router hooks to redirect unauthenticated users to the login page and optionally notify users when access is restricted.

methods.name: ProtectedRoute
methods.description: React component that protects routes by checking authentication status and redirecting unauthenticated users.

parameters.name: onNotify
parameters.description: Optional callback to notify when user is unauthenticated.
